accepted.quote: H.R. 2516 requires accrediting bodies to allow institutions to compel students, employees, or independent contractors to adhere to a statement of faith or adhere to a religious code of conduct consistent with the stated religious mission or religious tenets of the organization, which could sweep so broadly as to implicate violations of civil rights laws and even campus safety laws.
accepted.rationale: The passage warns that the religious-institution provision risks violating civil rights and campus safety laws.
